notes.title: How to play? - Mini Game
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/8591f200360306b0a5c136f6edd2b5c82d9db61b.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/b06722147f9c3ef662d027dabf5246f9a5cf7922.png
1. 1 ~ 3 Select the stage.
- Each stage has a different difficulty level.
- Final winner of each stage is recorded

2. choose a weapon.
- Play 'Repair' and 'Challenge' to obtain the 'Get Weapon' achievement.

3. Attack power increases when you clear 'Repair' and 'Challenge'

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/85c5982fb2d79a52f1d11991a1c57e07b823156e.png
Keyboard and mouse

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/5002d1b298abb4a1e084c1b1e6045bcd1845c6bc.png
Gamepad

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43843059/1139e1808c51a23e4a7686d70ef70c214044b922.png
Hp - add stamina by 2
Hint - add hint (99 limit)
Time - add time by 5 seconds
